provenance.design: Two builds, one host. Arms interleaved per round with the within-pair order flipped on alternate rounds; the statistic is the median of WITHIN-round ratios plus an exact two-sided sign test. A block design was tried in phase 1 and failed on a contended node, reporting a 1.85x speedup as a 0.81x regression.
provenance.what_is_under_test: Two things. (1) us_per_cell__collate FLAT: the top-K crop moved out of collate_cell into tokenize::crop::top_k and the kernel now takes reusable scratch instead of allocating three Vecs per cell. The crop is byte-identical (the cross-repo encoder_crop_golden.json is unchanged and green), so only the wall can have moved, in either direction — the scratch removes allocations, the call boundary adds one. Flat is the expected result and a move either way is a finding, not a budget. (2) The four per-kernel tokenisation arms, captured for the first time.
provenance.what_this_is_not: The four us_per_cell__{crop,rank,bin,sample} metrics exist ONLY on the after build and carry no ratio; they are absent from the A/B table by design and are reported one-armed by _phase3_tokenize_summary.py. NO floor is proposed from this capture — thresholds.yaml item 22 records what would have to be true to author one. Two of the four arms are fixture-gated (bin needs >= 2 distinct non-zero values per row, sample needs median nnz/cell above n=1024) and report themselves not applicable rather than producing a number over the wrong branch; the per-arm verdict is in each round record's tokenize block.
provenance.records_are_reduced: Each round is the median over the benchmark's own runs of the named metrics, not a full BenchmarkResult.to_dict() — but the full result is carried alongside under result, so the schema_version / system / runs envelope docs/benchmark_manifest.md describes is present.
provenance.crop_premise_not_gated: The crop arm does NOT assert that it truncates. Its cost is the sort over the row's positive entries, which runs whatever k is; k only decides how much of the output is PAD-init. At k=2048 against ~1950 nnz/cell on tabula it does not truncate at all, which Phase 1 measured. crop_fill_ratio is recorded instead so a reader can see how much of the wall is PAD-init.
